Anna

subject: RE: Help with purchasing Garmin devices
body:
Hi Anne,

 

There are a couple of different way for the device procurement. If it’s just a small amount of devices (up to 15 or so), and you can order via our website, then I can share discount codes for our webshop with you and you can order directly from there on your on.

If you prefer to order directly from Garmin Deutschland, then can you please share a billing- and deliver address with me so I can forward that information and my colleagues can draft up a quote for you?

 

Best regards,

Leon

 

i.A. Dr. Leon Brudy (he/him)


Business Development Manager Garmin Health & B2B Sales EMEA
